acceptance: A committed or attached sweep evidence file lists, per benchmark, scale (SF 1 and SF 10 at least, 256 draws at SF 10), generation path and refreshed state, at least 512 draws with the observed counts
Every check applied to refreshed rows held on every draw in the sweep
A mutated refreshed-data result outside an applied bound is refused (test)
tests/integration/test_tpcds_official_submission.py passes for TPC-DS and TPC-H on DuckDB SF 1
context: Follows the root-cause work on the official-run canary of 2026-11-26 (v2 staging commits 0392343e22, 69a4d73604, e79b4ce8bd).
description:
## Problem
Queries measured after a refresh (TPC-H RF1/RF2, TPC-DS data maintenance) run on changed data. The staged integrity checks (feat/staging-crr-v2 at e79b4ce8bd, benchbox/core/validation/stream_checks.py) keep the LIMIT/one-row structural check and the must-return-rows check on those rows and skip the exact, invariant and range checks with a documented `data refreshed:` reason; a refreshed row whose reference is missing or stale is skipped entirely. This was needed because counts sampled on base data do not hold after a refresh: TPC-DS Q43 returned 8 rows on refreshed data where every base-data draw returned 6. As a result, every measured TPC-H row in an official run and the whole second TPC-DS throughput test get only the weakest check. Invariants on refreshed data were never swept.

## Change
- Sweep the existing invariants (counts that never varied) and must-return-rows statements on refreshed data with at least 512 parameter draws per scale (256 at SF 10), covering both generation paths and each refreshed state the official sequence produces (TPC-H after RF1, and in throughput; TPC-DS throughput after the Data Maintenance Test); apply each that holds on every draw. Re-derive the TPC-H SF 1 ranges for refreshed data by full enumeration only; never apply observed min-max ranges (owner decision 1 of 2026-11-25).

## Decision gates
- A failed check refuses the run (owner decision 2), so a bound may apply to refreshed rows only with zero violations across the sweep. A disputed failure is settled by DuckDB at the same data stamp.
- If no invariant survives the sweep, stop and report; keep the LIMIT/one-row structural check and the must-return-rows check only.

## Verification rubric
- A sweep evidence file lists, per benchmark, scale and statement, the draws, the refresh state and the observed counts.
- A mutated result outside an applied bound is refused; the official-run canary still passes.

## Guardrails (apply to every step of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, check, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix; only the pvm items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file. Stored outcomes change only through the rule; any change shows in the committed snapshot diff (scripts/corpus_compliance_snapshot.py) and is explained per bundle in the pull request body.
- No new stored class value. No reader decides anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- One implementation per concept: reuse existing helpers; make duplicate-check-delta stays at +0; no second copy of the rule, the roll-up, the row decision or the qualification comparator.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). User-facing changes add a changelog.d fragment; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run, after make heavy-status, with command, maximum run time and log path announced first. No live cloud runs. Never touch the lock, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force or BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off.
- Work in a linked worktree on the step's feature batch. Each batch is one pull request; run the local review before opening it; fix hosted-review findings. If the hosted review cannot complete, split the pull request so a reviewer can read it (owner, 2026-11-24). Never post a stand-in or adjudication, except on published-results pull requests, which follow the owner decision of 2026-11-24: an independent review with no Critical or Required findings, then a stand-in that cites it.
- Paths and line numbers were read on 2026-11-26 at feat/staging-crr-v2 e79b4ce8bd; re-read before editing and report drift instead of guessing.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded owner decision. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner; never substitute a different decision.
- Owner decisions: crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan context, entries of 2026-11-22, 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25. Design: the spec-faithful validation plan summarized in crr-00 (qualification test, integrity checks, official-mode sequence).
